summary: Operational.co is a self-hosted tool designed to aggregate and display product alerts within a live chronological interface. It provides a centralised timeline view for tracking operational events emitted by your applications. The project is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits developers or small teams looking for a dedicated, self-hosted timeline to monitor product notifications without relying on a managed third-party service.
watchOut: The project has a relatively small community base and modest repository activity, meaning you may encounter unaddressed bugs or slow feature development. Additionally, the AGPL-3.0 licence places strict copyleft requirements on your modifications if you choose to adapt the codebase.
deployNotes: Because the application is packaged for Docker and built on Node.js, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
